decision_value: The verified pipeline uses a generic affine Jacobian backend whose addition was counted as 70M+3S+I. Faster arithmetic is a distinct implementation lead, not a claim that the observed IC-to-rho gap disappears. Favorable inversion prices alone do not prove a backend improvement.
